controls.title: Access Enforcement & Least Privilege
controls.description: The information system enforces approved authorizations for logical access to information and system resources.
controls.mappingRationale: Verifies that IAM permissions and workload identities restrict access to minimum necessary resources.

controls.title: Information Flow Enforcement & Segmentation
controls.description: The information system enforces approved authorizations for controlling the flow of information within the system and interconnected systems.
controls.mappingRationale: Verifies traffic boundaries, VPC peering controls, and ingress boundaries protecting sensitive backend enclaves.

controls.title: Least Privilege & Privilege Escalation Prevention
controls.description: The organization employs the principle of least privilege, allowing only authorized accesses for users and processes.
controls.mappingRationale: Detects root containers, privileged pods, and Docker daemon socket mount vectors.

controls.title: Boundary Protection & Demilitarized Zones
controls.description: The information system monitors and controls communications at external boundaries and key internal boundaries.
controls.mappingRationale: Evaluates public security groups, open ports, and unencrypted ingress pathways.

controls.title: Flaw Remediation & Known Vulnerability Patching
controls.description: The organization identifies, reports, and corrects system flaws and installed third-party software flaws.
controls.mappingRationale: Detects known software vulnerabilities and critical CVE advisories in application dependencies.

controls.title: Physical Access Authorizations
controls.description: The organization develops, approves, and maintains a list of individuals with authorized physical access to the facility.
controls.mappingRationale: NOT OBSERVABLE: Physical access badge readers and facility entry logs cannot be verified from code or cloud architecture.

controls.title: Personnel Screening & Background Checks
controls.description: The organization screens individuals prior to authorizing access to the system.
controls.mappingRationale: NOT OBSERVABLE: Employee criminal background checks and drug screenings are HR business processes.
